boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-admission activities and spaces at Harding University and in Searcy.

cards.title: Hear the University Chorus
cards.subtitle: Harding University Department of Music, Searcy
cards.notes: Check the Department of Music calendar, then meet friends before the program and stay afterward to compare favorite pieces.
cards.short_summary: A student-ensemble concert with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding states that its Department of Music hosts multiple student concerts with free admission throughout the school year and lists University Chorus among the performing groups.
cards.source_title: Community Events, Partnerships and Engagement | Harding
cards.access_notes: For all ages; confirm the current concert date and venue with Harding Music before going.

cards.title: Catch a Concert Choir program
cards.subtitle: Harding University Department of Music, Searcy
cards.notes: Use the music schedule to pick a date, arrive together a little early, and make the concert the centerpiece of an evening walk.
cards.short_summary: A free-admission student choir performance.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding states that its Department of Music hosts multiple student concerts with free admission throughout the school year and lists Concert Choir among the performing groups.
cards.source_title: Community Events, Partnerships and Engagement | Harding
cards.access_notes: For all ages; confirm the current concert date and venue with Harding Music before going.

cards.title: Listen to the Jazz Band
cards.subtitle: Harding University Department of Music, Searcy
cards.notes: Find a listed Jazz Band date, invite a small group, and plan a few minutes afterward to talk through the set.
cards.short_summary: A free-admission Harding student music event.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding states that its Department of Music hosts multiple student concerts with free admission throughout the school year and lists Jazz Band among the performing groups.
cards.source_title: Community Events, Partnerships and Engagement | Harding
cards.access_notes: For all ages; confirm the current concert date and venue with Harding Music before going.

cards.title: Go to a Wind Ensemble concert
cards.subtitle: Harding University Department of Music, Searcy
cards.notes: Choose a Wind Ensemble performance from the current schedule and meet at the venue so no one has to navigate alone.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled student wind-performance option without admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding states that its Department of Music hosts multiple student concerts with free admission throughout the school year and lists Wind Ensemble among the performing groups.
cards.source_title: Community Events, Partnerships and Engagement | Harding
cards.access_notes: For all ages; confirm the current concert date and venue with Harding Music before going.

cards.title: See the Percussion Ensemble
cards.subtitle: Harding University Department of Music, Searcy
cards.notes: Look for a Percussion Ensemble date on the music calendar and arrive on time; programs and venues can vary by concert.
cards.short_summary: A free student-ensemble performance to share.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding states that its Department of Music hosts multiple student concerts with free admission throughout the school year and lists Percussion Ensemble among the performing groups.
cards.source_title: Community Events, Partnerships and Engagement | Harding
cards.access_notes: For all ages; confirm the current concert date and venue with Harding Music before going.

cards.title: Attend an Orchestra concert
cards.subtitle: Harding University Department of Music, Searcy
cards.notes: Use the current music listings to choose an Orchestra performance and coordinate a simple meet-up before the downbeat.
cards.short_summary: A free-admission student orchestra concert.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding states that its Department of Music hosts multiple student concerts with free admission throughout the school year and lists Orchestra among the performing groups.
cards.source_title: Community Events, Partnerships and Engagement | Harding
cards.access_notes: For all ages; confirm the current concert date and venue with Harding Music before going.

cards.title: Browse Stevens Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Stevens Art and Design Center, Harding University
cards.notes: Visit during weekday gallery hours, take one slow lap together, then each point out a work that sparked a question.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus gallery with changing professional and student work.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding lists Stevens Art Gallery hours as Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., and explicitly states that admission is free.
cards.source_title: Stevens Art Gallery | Harding University
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor of the Stevens Art and Design Center near the Hammon Student Center; listed hours are weekdays, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Join the Faith and Business Symposium
cards.subtitle: Harding University, Homecoming weekend
cards.notes: Watch Harding’s Homecoming information for the speaker lineup, then choose one panel to attend with friends and discuss afterward.
cards.short_summary: An annual campus seminar of speakers and panels.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding describes the Faith and Business Symposium as a free annual seminar during Homecoming weekend, with speakers and panels open to the community.
cards.source_title: Community Events, Partnerships and Engagement | Harding
cards.access_notes: For all ages; held during Homecoming weekend. Check Harding’s current Homecoming schedule for program details.

cards.title: Take a group exercise class
cards.subtitle: Ganus Activities Complex recreation program, Harding University
cards.notes: Review recreation information, choose a class that suits the group, and bring only the gear the activity calls for.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation class offered without a class charge.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding’s recreation program explicitly offers free group exercise classes to students.
cards.source_title: Recreation | Intramural and Club Sports | Harding
cards.access_notes: Free for Harding students; review Ganus Activities Complex requirements and current class information before attending.

cards.title: Cool off at Berryhill’s splash pad
cards.subtitle: Berryhill Park, 501 Davis Drive, Searcy
cards.notes: Go during the listed splash-pad window, bring water and a towel, and pair it with a walk around the park’s trail.
cards.short_summary: A free outdoor splash pad beside Berryhill Park’s playground.
cards.evidence_claim: Experience Searcy states that the Berryhill Park Splash Pad is completely free to enjoy and that admission is free.
cards.source_title: Splash Pads in Searcy | Experience Searcy
cards.access_notes: Berryhill Park’s official city page lists the splash pad as open 8 a.m.–8 p.m.; it is at 501 Davis Drive.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Harding gatherings and practices spanning worship, service, student performance, and campus celebrations.

cards.title: Spring Sing
cards.subtitle: Annual musical revue involving Harding social clubs
cards.notes: Check the official ticket page before planning a visit, then watch the club shows, hosts, ensemble, and jazz band perform together.
cards.short_summary: A large annual student musical revue staged in Benson Auditorium.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding describes Spring Sing as an annual musical revue involving nearly 1,000 students from more than 20 social clubs.
cards.source_title: Spring Sing | Harding University
cards.access_notes: The official page lists the next announced performance dates and directs visitors to ticket information.

cards.title: John H. Ryan Sweepstakes Award
cards.subtitle: Spring Sing’s annual top club-show award
cards.notes: Read the current Spring Sing program after the judged performances to see which social-club show receives the Sweepstakes recognition.
cards.short_summary: A recurring award that connects Spring Sing competition to a charity donation.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding states that Spring Sing club shows are judged and that the John H. Ryan Sweepstakes Award prize money goes to the winning club's chosen charity.
cards.source_title: Spring Sing | Harding University
cards.access_notes: This award is announced as part of the annual Spring Sing program; event access follows the current ticket policy.

cards.title: Spring Sing Spirit Award
cards.subtitle: Peer-voted recognition within Spring Sing
cards.notes: Follow the official Spring Sing updates during performance weekend to learn which club show receives the peer-voted Spirit Award.
cards.short_summary: A yearly Spring Sing honor based on club directors’ vote.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding says Spring Sing club directors vote annually for a Spirit Award recognizing the show that demonstrated the spirit of Jesus Christ during rehearsal and performance.
cards.source_title: Spring Sing | Harding University
cards.access_notes: The recognition is part of Spring Sing; consult the current event information for attendance details.

cards.title: Harding University Chapel
cards.subtitle: Weekday worship gathering in Benson Auditorium
cards.notes: Confirm the current chapel schedule and attendance expectations, then arrive on time for a respectful weekday worship gathering.
cards.short_summary: A campus worship practice Harding traces to its first semester in 1924.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding's University Historical Collections calls chapel an important tradition dating to the university's first semester and describes weekday chapel services in Benson Auditorium.
cards.source_title: Harding University Chapel | University Historical Collections
cards.access_notes: Chapel times and access expectations can vary; verify current arrangements through Harding before attending.

cards.title: Inspire Bible Lectureship
cards.subtitle: Long-running Harding Bible lecture gathering
cards.notes: Review the College of Bible and Ministry event listing when dates are posted, then select sessions that match your interests.
cards.short_summary: A university gathering Harding says has been part of its life since its first fall as a four-year college.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding states that its Bible Lectureship tradition began in its first fall as a four-year college and brings together students and friends of the university.
cards.source_title: Bible and Ministry Events | Harding University
cards.access_notes: Program dates, registration, and session access are set for each year; use the official event listing before making plans.

cards.title: Stampede
cards.subtitle: New-student orientation and welcome weekend
cards.notes: Incoming students should follow the official move-in and session schedule, using the weekend to learn campus routines and meet peers.
cards.short_summary: Harding’s required orientation experience for incoming first-year and transfer students.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding identifies Stampede as its new-student orientation and welcome weekend and says it is required for incoming freshmen and transfer students.
cards.source_title: Stampede | Harding University
cards.access_notes: The official page lists 2026 dates, registration timing, and eligibility; it is a student-only experience.

cards.title: Bisons for Christ
cards.subtitle: Annual community service day
cards.notes: Use the VOMO sign-up process or contact Community Connection to join a project, request transportation, or submit a project idea.
cards.short_summary: A yearly service day connecting Harding participants with local projects.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding describes Bisons for Christ as an annual day of service in which students connect with and serve their communities through projects.
cards.source_title: Bisons for Christ | Harding University
cards.access_notes: Project lists and sign-up details are provided through VOMO or the Office of Community Connection.

cards.title: Harding Homecoming
cards.subtitle: Annual alumni, student, and campus celebration
cards.notes: Use the official schedule to choose a daytime activity, such as chapel or the Harding History Tour, before arranging travel.
cards.short_summary: A fall gathering that combines alumni return, campus activities, and Bison events.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding's official Homecoming page lists its 2026 celebration and a self-guided Harding History Tour among the scheduled activities.
cards.source_title: Homecoming | Harding University
cards.access_notes: Specific events, including athletic contests and performances, may have separate access or ticket requirements.

cards.title: Harding Lights
cards.subtitle: Annual campus holiday light display
cards.notes: Visit during the announced seasonal display period and take a walk around the Front Lawn while respecting campus operations and weather.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal light display that links Harding’s Front Lawn with Searcy’s holiday programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding describes #HardingLights as an annual university light display, beginning with a lighting ceremony and continuing through New Year's.
cards.source_title: Holidays at Harding | Harding University
cards.access_notes: The official page says the display begins with a lighting ceremony and continues through New Year's; confirm the upcoming season's dates.

cards.title: Harding Family Weekend
cards.subtitle: Annual campus weekend for students and families
cards.notes: Register through the official Family Weekend page when registration opens, then build a visit around the published campus schedule.
cards.short_summary: A recurring opportunity for Harding students to welcome family members to campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding's student-written university news describes Family Weekend as an annual tradition for families to join students, faculty, and staff in celebrating the Harding community.
cards.source_title: Welcome Home for Family Weekend | Harding University News
cards.access_notes: Harding lists Family Weekend dates and asks families to register; individual scheduled activities can have separate requirements.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Harding University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A walkable, under-21-safe sequence of named Harding campus landmarks for getting oriented during a first weekend.

cards.title: Start on the Front Lawn
cards.subtitle: Stop 1 · campus orientation walk
cards.notes: Begin at the Front Lawn, then use the official map to match nearby academic buildings and paths before choosing your next stop.
cards.short_summary: Use the central lawn as a visual starting point for a self-guided campus walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Front Lawn is labeled on Harding University’s official Searcy campus map.
cards.source_title: Searcy Campus Map | Buildings and Parking | Harding
cards.access_notes: Use public campus walkways and follow posted university access guidance.

cards.title: Find the Bell Tower
cards.subtitle: Stop 2 · landmark check-in
cards.notes: Walk to the Bell Tower and take a moment to orient yourself using its position on the campus map before continuing around campus.
cards.short_summary: A named campus landmark that helps anchor the route.
cards.evidence_claim: Bell Tower is labeled on Harding University’s official Searcy campus map.
cards.source_title: Searcy Campus Map | Buildings and Parking | Harding
cards.access_notes: View from campus walkways; do not enter restricted areas.

cards.title: Pause by the Lily Pool
cards.subtitle: Stop 3 · outdoor reset
cards.notes: Continue to the Lily Pool for a short outdoor pause, then check the map for the library, residence halls, and academic buildings nearby.
cards.short_summary: A named waterside landmark on the official campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: Lily Pool is labeled on Harding University’s official Searcy campus map.
cards.source_title: Searcy Campus Map | Buildings and Parking | Harding
cards.access_notes: Stay on designated paths and observe any posted safety guidance around water.

cards.title: Get acquainted with Brackett Library
cards.subtitle: Stop 4 · study and resource stop
cards.notes: Step inside during open hours to locate study rooms, public workstations, the Writing Center, and the library service desk for future use.
cards.short_summary: The library offers study spaces, workstations, student support services, and lending extras.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding says Brackett Library offers public workstations, study rooms, the Writing Center, Media Center, and resources for students.
cards.source_title: Brackett Library | Catalog, Archives & Research | Harding
cards.access_notes: Building access and service availability vary; check the library’s current information before visiting.

cards.title: Locate the Hammon Student Center
cards.subtitle: Stop 5 · campus-services waypoint
cards.notes: Use the official map to find the Hammon Student Center, then note its location relative to the nearby Heritage and science buildings.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed student-center waypoint for building familiarity.
cards.evidence_claim: Hammon Student Center is labeled on Harding University’s official Searcy campus map.
cards.source_title: Searcy Campus Map | Buildings and Parking | Harding
cards.access_notes: Confirm current building access and any event-specific entry requirements on arrival.

cards.title: Spot the Heritage Building
cards.subtitle: Stop 6 · north-campus landmark
cards.notes: Walk past the Burks American Heritage Building and use the map to identify its position near Market Avenue and the campus parking areas.
cards.short_summary: A named campus building that helps establish the north side of the route.
cards.evidence_claim: Burks American Heritage Building is labeled on Harding University’s official Searcy campus map.
cards.source_title: Searcy Campus Map | Buildings and Parking | Harding
cards.access_notes: Exterior viewing is appropriate; follow posted access guidance for interior spaces.

cards.title: Mark the Science Center
cards.subtitle: Stop 7 · academic-building waypoint
cards.notes: Find the Pryor-England Science Center on the map and use the exterior as a reference point for navigating the surrounding academic buildings.
cards.short_summary: A named science building on Harding’s official campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: Pryor-England Science Center is labeled on Harding University’s official Searcy campus map.
cards.source_title: Searcy Campus Map | Buildings and Parking | Harding
cards.access_notes: Follow posted building-access guidance; academic spaces may be unavailable outside scheduled use.

cards.title: Find Benson Auditorium
cards.subtitle: Stop 8 · event-venue landmark
cards.notes: Locate Benson Auditorium during your walk so you can recognize the venue when a campus program or performance is scheduled there.
cards.short_summary: A named auditorium that appears on the official Searcy campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: Benson Auditorium is labeled on Harding University’s official Searcy campus map.
cards.source_title: Searcy Campus Map | Buildings and Parking | Harding
cards.access_notes: Entry depends on scheduled events and venue guidance; check event details before attending.

cards.title: Pass the Stevens Art & Design Center
cards.subtitle: Stop 9 · creative-campus landmark
cards.notes: Add the Stevens Art & Design Center to your route and use the map to connect it with the nearby Cone Chapel and education buildings.
cards.short_summary: A named art and design destination on the official campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevens Art & Design Center is labeled on Harding University’s official Searcy campus map.
cards.source_title: Searcy Campus Map | Buildings and Parking | Harding
cards.access_notes: Observe posted access rules; interior studios and classes may not be open to visitors.

cards.title: Finish at First Ladies Garden
cards.subtitle: Stop 10 · quiet outdoor finish
cards.notes: End the orientation loop at First Ladies Garden, then revisit the map to choose a direct, well-marked route back to your residence hall.
cards.short_summary: A named garden that provides a calm final map waypoint.
cards.evidence_claim: First Ladies Garden is labeled on Harding University’s official Searcy campus map.
cards.source_title: Searcy Campus Map | Buildings and Parking | Harding
cards.access_notes: Use public paths and respect any temporary closures or posted garden guidance.
